title: Intrinsic Information Rates of Summaries in Simulation-Based Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.34703v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simulation-based inference often encodes observations $Y$ into a fixed-dimensional summary $S$, with the posterior conditioning only on $S$. While exact preservation often requires infinite information, any such summary imposes a finite information budget on inference which is rarely an explicit choice or measurement. In this paper, we make the budget explicit by modeling the summary as a lossy channel from $Y$ to $S$, and ask two questions: how large must the budget be, and how best is it spent? First, we show for parametric models that this budget, measured by the mutual information $I(Y;S)$, grows unboundedly as the posterior concentrates, even when fixed-dimensional sufficient statistics exist. More generally, the required budget is set by the distribution of the random posterior, and we bound it from above by quantizing posteriors and from below by converses that weight each posterior state by its probability. translated_title: 基于模拟的推断中摘要的内在信息速率
translated_abstract: 基于模拟的推断通常将观测值 $Y$ 编码为固定维度的摘要 $S$，而后验分布仅以 $S$ 为条件。虽然完整保留信息通常需要无限的信息量，但任何此类摘要都会对推断施加一个有限的信息预算，而这个预算很少被显式地选择或度量。在本文中，我们通过将摘要建模为从 $Y$ 到 $S$ 的有损信道来使这一预算显式化，并提出两个问题：这一预算必须有多大，以及如何最有效地使用它？首先，我们证明对于参数模型，这一预算（以互信息 $I(Y;S)$ 度量）会随后验分布的集中而无界增长，即使存在固定维度的充分统计量也是如此。更一般地，所需预算由随机后验的分布决定，我们通过将后验量化给出其上界，并通过以每个后验状态的概率进行加权的逆定理给出其下界。其次，我们证明了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将基于模拟推断中的摘要建模为有损信息信道，证明了所需的信息预算（互信息 $I(Y;S)$）会随后验分布集中而无界增长（即使存在固定维充分统计量），并通过量化后验与概率加权逆定理给出了所需信息速率的上下界。
en_tdlr: This paper models summaries in simulation-based inference as lossy channels, proving that the required information budget measured by mutual information I(Y;S) grows unboundedly as the posterior concentrates—even when fixed-dimensional sufficient statistics exist—and provides upper and lower bounds on the intrinsic information rate via posterior quantization and probability-weighted converses.
